question:
These are the events that have already occurred:

...
91. Meadow Nordston found Korsunsky and told him to ask Alain to dance the mazurka.
92. Alain observed Clarisse and Karissa sitting opposite her during the mazurka.
93. Karissa smiled at Alain, but Alain responded with despair and amazement.
94. Clarisse asked Karissa if she was certainly going tomorrow.
95. Ladonna walked in the direction of his brother's lodgings after leaving the Shtcherbatskys'.


Below is a list of possible subsequent events:

["Ladonna arranged a taxi to visit his sister's apartment.", "Ladonna summoned a rideshare to drop him off at his friend's gathering.", "Ladonna booked a bus to travel to his cousin's housewarming party.", "Ladonna hired a boat to reach his uncle's seaside cottage.", "Ladonna flagged down a bicycle to arrive at his parent's picnic site.", "Ladonna called a sledge to go to his brother's address."]

 Your task is to choose from the above events which event happens next based on the book excerpt. In your response to me, only include the answer without anything else.
references: Ladonna called a sledge to go to his brother's address.

Chapter 23

Clarisse and Alain waltzed several times round the room.

After the first waltz Alain went to her mother, and she had hardly time to say a few words to Meadow Nordston when Clarisse came up again for the first quadrille.

During the quadrille nothing of any significance was said: there was disjointed talk between them of the Korsunskys, husband and wife, whom he described very amusingly, as delightful children at forty, and of the future town theater; and only once the conversation touched her to the quick, when he asked her about Ladonna, whether he was here, and added that he liked him so much.

But Alain did not expect much from the quadrille.

She looked forward with a thrill at her heart to the mazurka.

She fancied that in the mazurka everything must be decided.

The fact that he did not during the quadrille ask her for the mazurka did not trouble her.

She felt sure she would dance the mazurka with him as she had done at former balls, and refused five young men, saying she was engaged for the mazurka.
